Hildegard 0.1.9 is a pre-alpha. Update every device you own from any one of them, or have your AI app do it for you.

## Install

- **macOS and Linux:** `curl -fsSL https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.sh | sh`
- **Windows (PowerShell):** `irm https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.ps1 | iex`
- **Desktop app:** pick your system's download below, or from [dbaney.com/hildegard](https://dbaney.com/hildegard/).

Installed already? Hildegard 0.1.5 and later find this release and update themselves, or run `hildegard update`.

## New

- **Signed updates, everywhere.** 0.1.8 was the first release signed with Hildegard's update key, so installs now find
  each release by themselves. Each one checks the signature before it installs anything, then starts again.
- **Update your other devices from here.** Settings › Devices shows the version each of your devices runs, and an
  **Update** button when a release is out. A device that is rendering updates once its render finishes. In a
  terminal, `hildegard update <device>`, or `hildegard update all` for every device and then this one.
- **Agents keep Hildegard up to date.** The new `update_hildegard` tool lets your AI app check what each device runs
  and update it for you. [INSTALL-FOR-AGENTS.md](https://github.com/baney75/hildegard/blob/main/INSTALL-FOR-AGENTS.md)
  shows agents the commands.

## Fixed

- Before a release offered updates, the update check said GitHub couldn't be reached. It now says the newest release
  doesn't offer updates yet, and Settings says how often Hildegard checks before its first check.

Devices on 0.1.8 or earlier can't be updated from another device yet; they update themselves to 0.1.9, and from then
on any of your devices can update the others.
